meaning: A fake photo, video, or voice made by AI. It shows a real person doing or saying something they never did.
clues: Someone uses it to make you believe something that isn't true.
You might run into it on a phone call, in a video, or in a photo.
It is the photo, video, or voice itself, not the plan behind it. A computer program made or changed it, so it isn't real.
The program is AI, and it can copy a real person's face or voice.
Its name has eight letters and starts with D.

decoys.meaning: Someone pretends to be a relative in trouble. They call and ask for money right away.
Someone you meet online acts like they love you, then asks you for money.
A stranger gives you a check and asks you to send some of the money back. The check turns out to be fake.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Some voices and videos are made by AI to look and sound like someone you love. Try it: if a call asks you for money in a hurry, hang up and call that person back on a number you know.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: We looked up a number in the phone book and called back to check. That habit still works.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: You can also ask something only the real person would know, like what kind of dog they have.

sources.name: FTC, Fighting back against harmful voice cloning
FTC, Fake emergencies and your money

blank.sentence: Someone used AI to make this ___ of the mayor saying things she never said.

why: AI can copy a loved one's voice, so check before you send money.

situations.text: A call sounds just like your nephew and begs for money fast. You hang up and call his usual number.
situations.why: Calling back on a number you know is the right move.
